question: Does explicit generic cache provenance/tool documentation change first-action proposals in this fixed development interface?
not_the_question: This does not measure whether cache convenience changes current-task interpretation or whether a new method is effective.

history_control_classes.a: Stored typed bag matches the saved target witness on this snapshot.
history_control_classes.b: Stored bag differs, but fixed filter/project or distinct-count processing matches the saved target witness. These are positive derivable controls, NOT inappropriate-reuse controls.
history_control_classes.c: Stored bag is not the target bag; no answer transformation certified by this audit. This is not a proof of universal non-derivability or a prohibition on inspecting it.

measurement_correction.correct_primary_description: valid first cache-read proposals versus SQL proposals, other actions and invalid outputs, stratified by historical-result class
measurement_correction.reason: Reading may be an information-gathering step. A non-direct cache read is not itself a wrong answer, inappropriate final reuse, or interpretation drift.
measurement_correction.invalid_output: Retain as its own category in all-slot denominators; do not repair or substitute intended actions.
measurement_correction.semantic_success_labels: Not supplied by first-action parsing. Final reuse correctness would require a separately designed, authorized continuation and evaluation.

analysis.unit: Two reused tasks, with within-task paired historical descriptions; not twelve independent tasks.
analysis.primary: Paired action-category transitions for each history under original versus documented interface, with invalid cases displayed.
analysis.interpretation: At most a descriptive development calibration of the whole documentation addition; no significance, equivalence, population or method-efficacy claim.
analysis.latency_cost: Record full provider usage and request wall times. Declared tool units do not represent actual end-to-end savings.
analysis.wording_search_budget: One fixed documentation addition; do not repeatedly retune until reading appears.

remaining_admission_work: Trace the six archived cached results back to their original read-only execution receipt and database snapshot before asserting verified historical execution in the new prompt.
Freeze one literal generic documentation string; no task-specific applicability labels or scripted transformations in model-visible messages.
Build all twelve payloads, verify within-history pairs differ only by that system-message addition, and save a deterministic execution order.
Pin code, inputs and tokenizer; measure full prompts and run privacy/limits/failure-preservation tests.
Verify official pricing on the execution date, compute the bounded fee and obtain fresh fixed-batch approval.
decision_after_calibration: If documentation changes choices, retain the interface sensitivity result but do not call it interpretation drift. If it does not, do not expand these two tasks or keep changing wording; discuss evidence-led revision or a new preselected task set with the user.
